Title: The Unit Circle Volvelle — Mechanical Trigonometry Calculator
Description:
Zero-Battery Mechanical Trigonometry Calculator

The Unit Circle Volvelle is an indestructible, two-piece rotary disc calculator engineered for rapid trigonometric reference and spatial geometry comprehension—completely free of batteries or digital screens.

How It Works

  • Outer Ring (Fixed): Precision laser-engraved with standard angles (0° to 360°) and exact radian measures (0 to 2π).

100% 3D-Printed Polymer Construction

Fabricated using durable, recyclable engineering polymers with a snap-fit center pivot—zero metal screws, washers, or fasteners required. Designed to withstand backpack transit and years of desktop reference.
